summary: Large Assets include Monsters, Vehicles, Constructs, War Machines, Siege Beasts, and other unusually powerful battlefield Units. Unlike conventional troops, their profiles vary significantly and should be balanced individually.
note: This section is a design-reference guideline table, not a purchasable generic unit profile. Individual Large Assets are defined per-faction or per-encounter.

assetClasses.name: Lesser Asset
assetClasses.description: Small monsters, light constructs, and unusual equipment roughly comparable to elite troops or cavalry.

assetClasses.name: Standard Asset
assetClasses.description: Moderately powerful monsters, vehicles, or war machines with a distinctive combat or support role.

assetClasses.name: Greater Asset
assetClasses.description: Large monsters, heavy vehicles, and major battlefield threats with substantial durability and offensive power.

assetClasses.name: Centerpiece Asset
assetClasses.description: Exceptional monsters or war machines designed as major army investments, often requiring additional restrictions.

guidelines: A typical Large Asset has 6–12 or more Wounds, one or two major Attack profiles, and a defining passive rule.
Faction Leaders are a separate Character category, even when comparable to a Large Asset in power or cost.
